Capt main consumer delivery advanced by the sole implementer on 2026-11-02.

PyPI cc-transcript 14.45.38 confirmed available with all five public assets; no SDK rebuild or release allocation performed. Existing frozen 14-file patch and SDK38 pin/lock carried onto main, preserving subsequent schema-validation and cursor-logging changes. Normal commit hooks passed. All 16 delivered file hashes verified against the merge commit. No new expensive local tests/builds run; CI was pending at merge and is not claimed passed.

PR #584 https://github.com/yasyf/captain-hook/pull/584 merged 2026-11-02T20:18:28Z. Source commit 87eedf47fb8e1761613c59da59ea2a1045b8cdcc. Merge commit 43e07f9e07fc0d9e82090cb7021db302dab61a52. Annotated release v12.110.1, tag object 271da29a4b22b488b1e9e9baa9c9a2c36546b9c4, pushed through the official release workflow.

Official release run 41518082970: https://github.com/yasyf/captain-hook/actions/runs/41518082970; status in_progress, conclusion pending. One launch-state observation only. External gate: official release must publish verified Capt 12.110.1 artifacts before supported installation can proceed. No waiting/polling agent retained.

Installed provenance inspected before delivery: signed app 12.110.0 build 2199; capt-hook package 12.109.9 with embedded cc-transcript 14.45.36, read through /Users/yasyf/.local/share/uv/tools/capt-hook/bin/python -I. Standalone SDK CLI is distinct from embedded SDK and was not used as embedded-version evidence. Consumer patch had not previously shipped in official v12.110.0/main.

Task remains in progress with existing ownership and acceptance criteria. Next executable step after official publication: use the existing supported Capt updater/install flow, verify asset hashes and remove quarantine from verified binaries before first execution, inspect installed package metadata through its own interpreter, then run the existing installed-source registered-review verifier and verify the actual normal hook/domain path. Installation and affected-case recovery remain unproven.

Evidence: /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/cost-retro-20261102/capt-consumer-sdk38-forward/release-progress.json; /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/cost-retro-20261102/capt-consumer-sdk38-forward/shipped-manifest.json. Working tree clean. All protected sessions/services preserved; eight workers per root unchanged.
